name: Client Consultation & Treatment Consent
description: A comprehensive client consultation covering health history, medicines, allergies, skin and lifestyle, salon policies, informed treatment consent and a limited liability disclaimer.

fields.label: Before you begin
fields.bodyText:
Complete the health and preferences sections first. Then discuss the proposed treatment and the consent statements with your therapist before signing. Please complete this form before your treatment. Answer honestly and choose “Unsure” whenever you need help. Your therapist will discuss relevant answers with you before deciding whether to proceed, adapt or postpone a treatment. This form does not replace an individual consultation or medical advice.

Only share information relevant to your care. Optional questions may be left blank. If you would prefer to discuss sensitive information privately, tell your therapist before continuing.

fields.helpText: The salon providing your treatment.

fields.label: Occupation
fields.helpText: Optional; include it if work affects your skin, nails or treatment needs.

fields.label: Which treatment or treatments are you considering today?
fields.helpText: List all treatments you want discussed. The therapist will confirm the final treatment plan and price before treatment.

fields.label: Additional therapist / nail technician names
fields.helpText: Optional, if more than one therapist is involved. The performing therapist is also recorded with your visit.

fields.label: How this information will be used
fields.bodyText:
The salon named above will use your contact details, health answers and signed consent to assess treatment suitability, plan your care, communicate about this visit and maintain a record of your consultation. Relevant information may be accessed by authorised salon staff and service providers supporting those purposes. It is not consent to marketing or public use of photographs.

You may ask the salon to explain its privacy notice, who can access your record, how long it is kept, and how to request access or correction. You may withdraw consent to future processing, subject to lawful record-retention requirements. If you do not wish to provide information needed to assess a treatment safely, ask to speak privately with the therapist; the treatment may need to be postponed.

fields.label: Appointments and late arrivals
fields.bodyText: Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your appointment to allow time for consultation and preparation. If you arrive late, the salon may need to shorten, reschedule or cancel the appointment if there is not enough time to perform the treatment safely. Any change to the treatment or price will be explained to you before you agree to proceed.

fields.label: Cancellations and rescheduling
fields.bodyText: Please give at least 24 hours’ notice if you need to cancel or reschedule. The salon will try to offer another suitable time, subject to availability. A late cancellation or missed appointment may attract a reasonable cancellation charge where permitted by law. Any applicable charge must be disclosed in advance and take account of the notice given, the circumstances and whether the appointment can be filled. This policy does not remove any statutory right to cancel without a charge.

fields.label: Products, refunds and treatment concerns
fields.bodyText: Please raise any product or treatment concern with the salon as soon as reasonably possible so it can be assessed. Returns, refunds, remedies for defective products and service-quality concerns will be handled in accordance with applicable consumer law and the salon’s disclosed policy. Nothing in this form limits a right or remedy that the law provides. Ask for the policy before purchasing if you need more information.

fields.label: A respectful and safe salon
fields.bodyText: Please treat other clients and staff respectfully. The salon may decline or stop a service, or ask someone to leave, where behaviour is threatening, abusive, disruptive or creates a safety risk. This will be done fairly and in accordance with applicable law.

fields.label: Personal belongings and premises
fields.bodyText: Please take reasonable care of your personal belongings and tell staff about any safety concern or incident promptly. The salon’s responsibility for injury, loss, theft or damage will be determined under applicable law; entering the premises does not waive your legal rights.

fields.label: I have read the salon policies
fields.bodyText: I have had the opportunity to ask questions about appointments, cancellations, refunds, conduct and personal belongings, and understand the policies described above.

fields.label: Informed and voluntary treatment consent
fields.bodyText:
I request the treatment or treatments recorded for this visit. Before treatment starts, my therapist will confirm the proposed treatment, the area to be treated, the products or techniques, the price, expected benefits and limitations, relevant risks, aftercare and any reasonable alternatives, including postponing or having no treatment.

I may ask questions, decline a proposed treatment or ask for treatment to stop. Consent to this visit does not authorise an unrelated or materially changed treatment without further discussion and agreement. Results vary between people and a particular cosmetic result is not guaranteed.

I understand that this is a beauty or wellness service and is not a medical diagnosis or a substitute for care from a qualified healthcare professional. I will tell the therapist promptly if I feel pain, burning, irritation or other discomfort.

fields.label: Important: treatment risks and suitability
fields.bodyText:
Depending on the treatment and products used, potential effects may include temporary redness, sensitivity, irritation, bruising, an allergic reaction, burns, skin lifting, infection, or damage to skin or nails. Not every risk applies to every treatment. My therapist must explain the risks relevant to my proposed treatment, including any unusual or serious risk, before treatment begins.

I understand that incomplete health information, a change in my condition, or not following agreed aftercare may increase risk. A signed form does not itself establish that a treatment is suitable or replace the therapist’s assessment.

fields.label: Liability disclaimer — please read carefully
fields.bodyText:
I accept the inherent risks of the agreed treatment that have been clearly explained to me and that may occur despite reasonable care and skill. To the extent permitted by law, the salon and its staff are not responsible for an adverse outcome caused solely by relevant information I knowingly withheld or provided inaccurately, or by my failure to follow clearly explained aftercare.

This is not a blanket release of liability. Nothing in this form excludes or limits liability for negligence, gross negligence, deliberate wrongdoing, unsafe or defective products, or any injury, loss or consumer remedy for which liability cannot lawfully be excluded. My rights under applicable consumer law remain unaffected.

I understand that responsibility for any injury, reaction, loss or damage will depend on the facts and applicable law. I am not being asked to accept responsibility for the salon’s failure to provide services with reasonable care and skill.

fields.label: My information is accurate and complete
fields.bodyText: To the best of my knowledge, the information I have provided is accurate and complete. I have disclosed relevant medical conditions, medicines, supplements, allergies, products and recent procedures, and will tell the therapist about any changes before treatment. I will correct any earlier information that is no longer accurate.

fields.label: I freely consent to the agreed treatment
fields.bodyText: The proposed treatment and relevant risks have been explained in language I understand. I have had enough time to ask questions, my questions have been answered, and I understand that I can decline or ask to stop. I consent to the treatment recorded for this visit, subject to the therapist confirming it is suitable.

fields.label: I have read and understood the liability disclaimer
fields.bodyText: My attention has been drawn to the treatment risks and liability disclaimer above. I understand the limited allocation of responsibility described there and that my statutory rights are not waived.

fields.label: I understand the aftercare responsibilities
fields.bodyText: I will follow the aftercare explained to me and ask if anything is unclear. I will contact the salon about unexpected reactions or concerns and seek appropriate medical advice when needed.

fields.label: I am ready to sign
fields.bodyText: I have read this form, or it has been read and explained to me. I understand it and am signing voluntarily. If I do not understand or agree with a statement, I will speak to the therapist before signing.
